traceability.notes: The story 009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS is a concrete specification, not a planning-only doc. Its requirements (REQ-MAINT-DETECT/UPDATE/BATCH/VERIFY/REPORT/SAFE) are all implemented via the helpers in src/maintenance and exposed both programmatically and via the traceability-maint CLI. Multiple dedicated unit, integration, and performance tests explicitly reference this story and its requirement IDs and all pass in the current test run. The Maintenance CLI is documented in README.md, and behavior matches the documented subcommands and options. The acceptance criteria—core functionality, quality, integration with the existing project/ESLint setup, clear user feedback, robust error handling, and documentation—are all satisfied with concrete, passing tests and visible documentation. Therefore, the implementation for this story is fully complete and verified.
